text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome to Daisy's class.Today, we are going to learn more practice.In this period, you are going to read a classic fairy tale.Through reading, you will understand how the story develops and learn a moral lesson from the story.Please get your student's book and the worksheet ready.Goldfish or goldenfish have been considered as a symbol of luck and fortune since ancient times.They once became characters in a story.Do you know the name of the story?Bingo!That's the fisherman and the fish.Think about the question.What kind of story is it?Exactly, it's a fairy tale.Actually, it's a fairy tale based on a narrative poem.Do you know who wrote it?Yes, Alexandra Pushkin.He was the greatest Russian poet.He created the fisherman and the fish in 1833.Now let's read the story together and find out how it develops.Read the story and find out the setting and the characters.Great!You can get the answer at the very beginning of the story.Once upon a time, near the sea in Russia, who was in the story?The poor fisherman, his wife, and the goldenfish.What happened?Keep on reading.Read the first paragraph and answer the questions.You can find the questions on your worksheet task one.You have one minute to finish it.Time's up.Have you got all the answers?What happened to the fisherman one morning?Yes, he caught a goldenfish and the fish backed the fisherman to let him go.We can make the answer short like this.The goldenfish he caught backed to let him go.Here, back means qǐ qǒu.What did the goldenfish offer to him in return?He offered to grant the fisherman any wish in return.Here, grant means excellent.It means to make the fisherman's any wish come true.Now read out to me, grant.What did the fisherman do?He let the fish go without asking for anything.Unfortunately, the fisherman's wife knew about the goldenfish.She wanted to ask for many things.Please read paragraphs two to four and then answer the questions.You'll find the questions on your worksheet task two.This time I think one minute is enough.Have you finished?Good, let's check.How many wishes did the woman ask for?What were they?Four wishes.She wanted a new bucket, a new house, to be mayor of the city and to be queen of all the land.Were all her wishes granted?No, they weren't.In fact, three of them were granted.Why didn't the fish grant all her wishes?Let's keep on reading.Read paragraphs two to four again and find out the sentences related to the weather.Please move on to task three.You've got two minutes to do it.The story is getting more and more interesting, right?When asking for a new bucket, the sun was shining.When asking for a new house, the weather was getting bad.When asking to be mayor of the city, the sky was becoming dark.The waves were getting bigger.And when asking to be queen of all the land, there was a terrible storm.There were giant waves.There was thunder and lightning.Got it?Well, let's read the picture and think about the following questions to discover more.Here, implied means 暗示The sky was getting bigger.And when asking for a new house, the sun was shining.The sky was getting bigger.And when asking to be queen of all the land, the sun was shining.In what way did the weather change?From the picture, we can see, the more the woman wanted, the worse the weather was getting.What did the changes in the weather imply?They implied the emotional changes of the fish.Let's check out how his emotion changed.Shining sun means he was great, happy.Then the sky was becoming dark, which means he got a little angry.After hearing the woman wanted to be mayor, he was angry.But he still granted her wish.However, when the woman still wanted more, there was a terrible storm with thunder and lightning.Which means he became, yes, he became extremely angry.We can also say furious.So what was the turning point of the story?Excellent.When the woman demanded to be queen of all the land.Demand means ask someone for something in a very strong way.Now read after me.Demand.Well, after the turning point, the story was approaching the end.Read paragraph 4 and find out what happened at last.What happened at last?Very good.The golden fish never came back.All the things the fisherman's wife got from the fish disappeared.The fisherman and his wife became poor again.That's the whole story.Interesting, right?After reading the story, what do you think of the fisherman and his wife?Think about the question and try to find evidence to support your idea.Please move on to task 4.You've got two minutes to finish the task.Let's go back to the beginning.I'm sorry.What do you think of the fisherman?Undoubtedly, he was very kind.But he was.We can use the word cowardly.It means 懦弱的It means 懦弱的Why do you think so?Why do you think so?He let the fish go.He let the fish go without asking for anything at first.However, he never said no to his wife even if he wasn't willing to.Where can you find the evidence?Good job!In paragraph 2, he explained to the fish about his rude wife.In paragraph 3, he apologized to the fish.What do you think of his wife?Obviously, his wife was greedy, selfish, and rude.Perfect!In paragraph 2,After knowing about the golden fish,she shouted at her husband and called him a fool.In paragraph 3,after becoming mayor of the city,she told her husband he had to sleep in the old hut.After becoming mayor of the city,she even wanted to be queen of all the land.How greedy she was!However, in the end, everything stayed the same as before.Well, think about the question.What can we learn from the story?The story teaches us not to be greedy.Enough is as good as feast.知足者常乐No pains, no gains.Now I've thought about it.Now I think you can fully understand how the story develops.Retell the story from the fisherman's perspective.The following information may help you.You've got one minute to prepare.一天早上,我偷偷抓了一條金魚。驚喜的是,他勸我讓他離開,並承諾我將任何願望交還給他。我讓他離開了,並不再問任何問題。我回家後,我告訴我妻子發生了什麼事。妻子生氣,然後喊我。後來,她送我去海洋,向魚的新金魚交還。我非常生氣,但我沒有選擇。她收到金魚,她想要新的房子。她想要當城市的市長。我非常抱歉,因為我的醜女。我向魚道歉。他讓我開心,並承諾我將任何願望交還給他。我妻子仍然不滿意。我聽不到她說,她說她想當城市的市長。我不想再問任何願望給妻子。然而,我害怕我妻子。我再次到海洋去找魚。可惜,魚離開了,從來沒有回來。我回家後,我驚訝看到我妻子在門前坐著,跟著一個舊桶子。她把魚的所有東西都拿走了。我們再次變成貧窮。Kevin讓我們想像到我們在故事中是個人的。這就是我們今天需要學習的。今天家庭工作。這就是今天的課程結束。
